column1: # .zap/rules.tsv
# ZAP baseline scan rule suppressions
# Format: ruleId<TAB>action<TAB>reason
# Actions:
#   IGNORE   - suppress entirely (false positive / accepted risk)
#   WARN     - downgrade from FAIL to WARN
#   FAIL     - keep as failing (default; listed here for explicitness)
# Docs: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/docker/baseline-scan/
# To find rule IDs: run ZAP once without this file, capture the numeric
# IDs from the report, then add suppressions below with justification.
# SameSite=None is set intentionally on session cookie for cross-origin
# frontend ↔ API gateway calls (staging uses different origins).

column3: SameSite=None required by staging cross-origin setup

column1: # HttpOnly missing on non-sensitive UI preference cookie (no auth data).

column3: Preference cookie carries no sensitive data

column1: # CSP is enforced at the CDN layer (CloudFront); not set on origin.

column3: CSP delegated to CDN layer — not set on origin server

column1: # Permissions-Policy not yet adopted across all services — tracked in
# INFRA-412; accept risk until rollout complete.
# X-Powered-By removed in prod; still present in staging base image.

column3: X-Powered-By present in staging image only — stripped in prod

column1: # Server header reveals Nginx version on staging; masked in prod.

column3: Server version header present in staging only

column3: /api/search is a public read-only endpoint — wildcard CORS accepted

column3: Missing on binary attachment endpoints only (INFRA-398)

column1: # REST API uses Authorization header + CORS; no form-based POST.

column3: API uses Authorization header + CORS; not form-POST — CSRF N/A

column3: HTTP→HTTPS redirect is intentional and validated

column1: # Timestamp disclosure (e.g. Last-Modified) on static assets is expected.

column3: Timestamp on static assets is intentional cache-busting
